keyMappings:
# Tabs
unmap L
unmap H
map H previousTab
map L nextTab

# Link mode
unmap F
# unmap default link mode
unmap f
map : LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewTab
map ; LinkHints.activateMode

# History
unmap J
map J goBack
unmap K
map K goForward

# Omnibar
unmap m
map m Vomnibar.activateTabSelection
unmap o
map o Vomnibar.activateInNewTab
unmap O
map O Vomnibar.activate


# Utils
map ap togglePinTab
map am toggleMuteTab

map e passNextKey

unmap T
map T createTab

map < moveTabLeft
map > moveTabRight
